title: Core A2.5: a soldier course of 55 falls between its piers
summary: Fifty-five EC6-mortared soldiers span 3.575 m, the shortest odd course the engine lets fall (53 stands). The pier bases crack, the piers rock outward and the thrust drops; the middle of the course drops between its cracked joints and the end pieces follow, while the piers stand. This is the model's edge, not a design span: an elastic small-displacement field credits the stiff bonded piers with full thrust and ignores abutment spread, so real flat arches fail at much shorter spans.
